text:
jordyn (sec-eng): Heads up — external pentest vendor asked to include the KMS proxy and our role-swap flow in scope. We need a short RBAC change plan, audit-log export approach, and retest windows. Tentative dates: May 12-13 for initial run. Thoughts?

samir (platform): Do we have to expose KMS at all? can we limit to staging + metadata read? I don't want to give them Decrypt.

emily (ops): We should avoid giving Decrypt too. We can provide logs & presigned artifacts, rotate any creds after the test, and give them a bastion into staging if needed. Need list of endpoints they'll hit.

oliver (sre): Agree with staging-only. For paging, we should mute noisy KMS alerts during the window. Recommend ephemeral assessor role via SSO with short sessions. Also: add CloudTrail export to a read-only bucket.

jordyn (sec-eng): Proposed temp role: pt-assessor. Policy: allow kms:DescribeKey, kms:ListKeys, kms:GetPublicKey; deny kms:Decrypt/kms:Encrypt; s3:GetObject on specific evidence prefixes only. Sample policy snippet below:`
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:DescribeKey","kms:ListKeys","kms:GetPublicKey"], "Resource": "*"},
    {"Effect": "Deny", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"], "Resource": "*"},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-logs/staging/*"}
  ]
}
```

samir (platform): That looks good. Note: our KMS proxy enforces key-policy too — we must ensure an explicit Deny for Decrypt in both the IAM side and the key policy. Would prefer vendor to hit a jumpbox vs wide IP allowlist; their IPs change.

emily (ops): We can stand up a dedicated jumpbox in the staging VPC and give them one-time bastion creds for the scheduled windows. We'll pre-generate presigned URLs for logs and limit lifetime. I'll also check retention: we currently retain CloudTrail for 90d; can we extend to 1yr for this engagement? Need finance signoff for cost.

jordyn (sec-eng): Retest criteria: vendor must verify fixes; retest if any critical/major vulnerabilities remain. Propose retest slots: May 20 09:00-13:00 PDT and May 27 09:00-13:00 PDT. Also scheduling a 30-min dry run May 10 15:00 PDT to test jumpbox & presigned link flow.

sec-bot: Reminder: create security ticket and remediation tracker for the engagement.

oliver (sre): I'll own oncall during windows and the CloudTrail export. I'll also mute KMS Grant/Use alerts for scheduled windows.

samir (platform): I'll own the RBAC/IAM PR and key-policy update. Will add explicit Deny and SourceVpc condition for the staging keys. I’ll try to open PR by EOD Apr 28.

emily (ops): I'll provision the jumpbox, generate the presigned buckets, and put together the cost estimate for extended retention.

jordyn (sec-eng): One more: vendor wants to test role-swap (assume-role) flows. We should log AssumeRole events and add a short-lived session duration (1h). Also record the session tags.

samir (platform): I'll add CloudTrail filters for AssumeRole + STS:GetSessionToken. Also update key policy to disallow Decrypt in case of role-swap.

jordyn (sec-eng): Sounds good. Confirming dry run May 10 15:00 PDT. If anyone cannot make it please flag now.

emily (ops): I can make it.

samir (platform): I can make it.

oliver (sre): I can make it.

sec-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-PT-389 and assigned: samir, emily, oliver, jordyn.

jordyn (sec-eng): Thanks team — I'll follow up with the vendor to lock scope and send calendar invites for the dry run and primary windows.
notes: dry-run scheduled; PR owners assigned; ticket created
